children.name: Strata - Currency conversion
Converts a currency amount into another currency using a given FX rate Case 1: amount=100.0, from=USD, to=EUR, rate=0.9, expected=90.0
Converts a currency amount into another currency using a given FX rate Case 2: amount=50.0, from=EUR, to=USD, rate=1.1, expected=55.0
Converts a currency amount into another currency using a given FX rate Case 3: amount=200.0, from=GBP, to=USD, rate=1.25, expected=250.0
Strata - Date adjustments
Shifts a date onto a valid business day using a business day convention and holiday calendar Case 1: convention=Following, calendar=USNY, date=2024-01-06, expected=2024-01-08
Shifts a date onto a valid business day using a business day convention and holiday calendar Case 2: convention=Preceding, calendar=GBLO, date=2024-01-07, expected=2024-01-05
Shifts a date onto a valid business day using a business day convention and holiday calendar Case 3: convention=ModifiedFollowing, calendar=EUTA, date=2024-03-30, expected=2024-03-28
Shifts a date onto a valid business day using a business day convention and holiday calendar Case 4: convention=Following, calendar=USNY, date=2024-01-03, expected=2024-01-03
Strata - Day counts
Converts a date period into a year fraction for a given day count convention Case 1: dayCount=Act/360, start=2023-01-01, end=2023-07-01, expected=0.5027777777777778
Converts a date period into a year fraction for a given day count convention Case 2: dayCount=Act/365F, start=2024-01-01, end=2025-01-01, expected=1.0027397260273974
Converts a date period into a year fraction for a given day count convention Case 3: dayCount=30/360 ISDA, start=2024-01-15, end=2024-07-15, expected=0.5
Strata - Holiday calendars
Determines whether a given date is a holiday on a standard holiday calendar Case 1: calendar=USNY, date=2024-01-01, expectedHoliday=true
Determines whether a given date is a holiday on a standard holiday calendar Case 2: calendar=USNY, date=2024-01-02, expectedHoliday=false
Determines whether a given date is a holiday on a standard holiday calendar Case 3: calendar=GBLO, date=2024-12-25, expectedHoliday=true
Determines whether a given date is a holiday on a standard holiday calendar Case 4: calendar=EUTA, date=2024-03-02, expectedHoliday=true
Strata - Schedules
Builds a periodic schedule and generates the expected number of regular periods Case 1: start=2024-01-01, end=2025-01-01, frequency=P3M, expectedPeriods=4
Builds a periodic schedule and generates the expected number of regular periods Case 2: start=2024-01-01, end=2024-07-01, frequency=P1M, expectedPeriods=6
Builds a periodic schedule and generates the expected number of regular periods Case 3: start=2024-01-01, end=2025-01-01, frequency=P6M, expectedPeriods=2
Strata - Value adjustments
Applies a value adjustment (replace, delta amount, delta multiplier, multiplier) to a base value Case 1: baseValue=200.0, adjustment=ValueAdjustment[result = input + 20.0], expected=220.0
Applies a value adjustment (replace, delta amount, delta multiplier, multiplier) to a base value Case 2: baseValue=220.0, adjustment=ValueAdjustment[result = input + input * 0.1], expected=242.0
Applies a value adjustment (replace, delta amount, delta multiplier, multiplier) to a base value Case 3: baseValue=100.0, adjustment=ValueAdjustment[result = input * 1.5], expected=150.0
Applies a value adjustment (replace, delta amount, delta multiplier, multiplier) to a base value Case 4: baseValue=123.0, adjustment=ValueAdjustment[result = 999.0], expected=999.0
